title: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 C=8 energy: temperature-controlled A/B, Metrale Engine against vLLM + MTP
subtitle: Three arms at C=8 on one box and one instrument: the C=8 change (39ab52e6 + 0bf0df3e9, landed on main in #56), the previous main 39ab52e6, and vLLM 0.27.1 + MTP; 9 timed reps per arm

box.name: dgx2 (spark-43fa)
box.note: one box for all three arms, 2026-09-30 03:13-04:39 UTC, nothing else on the GPU

protocol: One harness process per timed rep (--reps 1 --warmup 0), so every rep draws a fresh prompt nonce and none hits the prefix cache. Reps run in 3-rep blocks; each block starts on a fresh server (Metrale) or a fresh container (vLLM) and sends one discarded warmup rep first. Every timed rep starts only after the die has cooled to 55 C or below with the server loaded and idle (nvidia-smi temperature.gpu polled every 5 s). Blocks are interleaved in block_order, three per arm. Energy is the harness's GPU-rail figure: nvidia-smi power.draw.average sampled every 250 ms and integrated over the rep window.

statistic.interval: two-sided 95% Student t on the mean, df 8 (t = 2.306)
statistic.comparison: Welch t on the per-rep J/token
statistic.short_reps: Three Metrale reps (m_F_B2_r3 7,923, m_F_B3_r3 8,172 and m_F_N3_r1 7,959 completion tokens of 8,192) had a request end on a stop token before OSL; J/token divides by the tokens actually generated, as the harness does, and no rep is excluded. Every rep has zero request errors and gpu_rail_trustworthy true.

arms.label: Metrale Engine 39ab52e6 + 0bf0df3e9
arms.build_note: 0bf0df3e9 is one commit on top of 39ab52e6: the register-resident GDN WY verify twins from 8 sequences (was 16). It landed on main as part of 93f378ead (#56).
